body:
Have you considered playing with the 5-10% percentage of wallet amount in relation the total amount that is requested; as this too would create sufficient stake in proposals being put forward and being successful. 
Maybe this complicates things but lets say a member / contributor that has met a certain time and participation threshold would fall into the 5-10% wallet bracket; but those that havent would require 5-10% of the entire amount asked. 

TBH i havent fully thought through the possibility branches on this tree; but just putting it out there for thought.  

Overall i like this idea, great work Zov!
